commentary.text: 61' The match is abandoned!
61' The match will be interrupted for a while due to some disturbances.
60' The corner is swung in but Montpellier can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
56' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
53' 0 - 2 Fantastic team goal! Lucas Stassin (St Etienne) was set free in the area by Zuriko Davitashvili and made no mistake with a lovely finish into the bottom right corner. 0:2.
53' The resulting set piece from Montpellier is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
51' St Etienne have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
49' Montpellier failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
46' Half-time substitution. Benjamin Bouchouari (St Etienne) will not participate anymore and Yunis Abdelhamid is coming on.
46' The game is over for Theo Sainte-Luce (Montpellier). Issiaga Sylla comes on for the second half.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Jean-Louis Gasset probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Rabby Nzingoula (Montpellier). He is replaced by Wahbi Khazri.
46' Referee Francois Letexier blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+3' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.

45+2' Theo Sainte-Luce (Montpellier) pounces on the cross into the centre of the box, but hangs his head in shame after sending his header well wide of the left post when the keeper was on his backside.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
45' Maxime Bernauer (St Etienne) should have been more careful. He commits a bad foul, receives his second yellow card and is sent-off!
45' What a chance! The ball is inside the box and Irvin Cardona (St Etienne) takes a first-time shot on goal, but his volley goes narrowly wide of the right post.

45' A pass travels right across the box to Benjamin Bouchouari (St Etienne) and gives him a sight of goal. He tries to beat the keeper inside the right post, but Benjamin Lecomte denies him with a decent save.
43' Tanguy Coulibaly (Montpellier) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
42' The resulting corner from Florian Tardieu (St Etienne) is cleared.
42' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Maxime Bernauer (St Etienne). Good work from St Etienne as they win a corner.
41' Florian Tardieu (St Etienne) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.

41' Pierre Ekwah (St Etienne) gets to the rebound outside the penalty box and unleashes a long-range shot towards the bottom right corner, but Benjamin Lecomte makes a decent save to stop the effort. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. St Etienne will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
40' Florian Tardieu (St Etienne) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates as he overhits the effort.
38' A rebound bounces out to Othmane Maamma (Montpellier) on the edge of the box, but he can't control his shot and it slips well wide of the right post.
37' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
37' Tanguy Coulibaly (Montpellier) announces himself with a close-range shot after a cross, but one of the defenders gets in the way of the ball to thwart him.
36' Florian Tardieu (St Etienne) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked.
34' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Tanguy Coulibaly (Montpellier).
32' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked.
30' Othmane Maamma (Montpellier) shoots after receiving a good pass. His effort from the edge of the box goes just wide of the right post.
28' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
27' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
26' Othmane Maamma (Montpellier) creates himself some space around the penalty spot and connects with the free kick. His header is so wild it sails way past the left post and behind for a goal kick.
26' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) takes the ball and sets it for the free kick.
23' Tanguy Coulibaly (Montpellier) is penalised for a foul. Francois Letexier had a clear view and blows his whistle.
20' Lucas Stassin (St Etienne) receives the ball in space inside the box and only has the keeper to beat, but sends his first-time shot well wide of the right post.
18' Good clearance! Othmane Maamma (Montpellier) received a low pass, but he didn't have time to do anything as one of the defenders quickly stole the ball off him.
15' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) is cautioned by the referee, who shows him a yellow card.
15' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) whips a long ball in from the free kick which is intercepted by Gautier Larsonneur.

15' The referee blows his whistle after Pierre Ekwah (St Etienne) does a good impression of a basketball player and handles the ball. It's a free kick to Montpellier, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
11' 0 - 1 Goal! Lucas Stassin (St Etienne) finds himself some space inside the box to get on the end of a pass from Irvin Cardona, then sends the ball inside the right post. 0:1.
10' The free kick from long range, taken by Montpellier, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
9' Maxime Bernauer (St Etienne) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
8' Zuriko Davitashvili (St Etienne) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
7' Florian Tardieu (St Etienne) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
7' St Etienne take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

6' Close! Florian Tardieu (St Etienne) picks up a pass and produces a ferocious strike towards the right post, but the goalkeeper gets his fingertips to the ball to keep it out. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to St Etienne.
5' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) picks up a pass and hits the ball towards the bottom right corner, but he can't generate enough power to trouble Gautier Larsonneur.
4' Montpellier enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out and the match is about to start. St Etienne will have the kick-off.
Francois Letexier will officiate today.
